urls.rationale: 120C-200 Lobbyist registration procedure: core lobbyist-registration section.
120C-206 Lobbyist principal's authorization: principal-side authorization tied to lobbyist registration.
120C-207 Lobbyist principal's fees: principal-side fee provision.
120C-210 Resignation and termination: termination of registration.
120C-215 Other persons required to register: scope-extension registration requirement (present at 2010, retained 2015, removed by 2025).
120C-220 Publication and availability of registrations: disclosure/transparency of registration filings.

notes: Excluded all 'Reserved for future codification purposes' placeholders (120C-202 through -205, -208, -209, -211 through -214, -216 through -219, and the 120C-221through120c-299 range) -- no statute body.
